atlanta.name: Atlanta
atlanta.configuration: CL-51 · 1942 exterior after the GameModels3D pasc006 A hull · reference design waterline

ballistics.basis: Provisional game calibration, not historical firing data. Linear k=0.5*1.225*0.25*area*muzzleSpeed/mass; no Mach curve. Angular/speed sigmas are estimated, capped at 3 sigma; no salvo correlation or rangefinder error. Legacy penetrationMm retained at 5000 m, 10 m launch/sea target, nominal speed (485.109 m/s); see assets/parts/calibrate-penetration.ts. Residual budget follows speed^1.4, including descent recovery; armor resistance paid separately.

ap.basis: Provisional AP game calibration, not historical fuze/filler data. Arming requires caliber/6 equivalent resistance in one non-ricochet contact; delay 35 ms at >=200 mm, otherwise 20 ms; fill 2.5% of projectile mass; fragment budget 8% of caliber in mm. Smaller AA AP remains inert. See assets/parts/author-ap.ts; blast radius and damage are bounded approximations.

he.basis: Provisional HE game calibration, not historical shell/stock data. Contact burst; fill 8% of nominal projectile mass, fragment budget caliber/6 in mm, burst damage twice the AP catalog value. 40% HE stock rounded down per barrel. Shares the gun nominal launch mass/speed/drag envelope as an approximation. See assets/parts/author-he.ts.

structuralPlating.note: Hull and superstructure plating read from the approved GameModels3D armour model (13 mm constructional hull and weather decks, 10 mm superstructure); provisional game values, not a verified plating schedule.

accuracy.exterior: Original loft and superstructure blocks measured from the approved GameModels3D pasc006 A hull (asc006_atlanta_1942) at its design waterline; fittings are independently modelled approximations. No historical-accuracy claim.
accuracy.internals: Machinery, magazines, flood spaces and stability are provisional game estimates; the visual reference does not establish internal plans.
accuracy.weapons: Sixteen 5-inch/38 in eight twin Mk 32 Mod 12 mounts (six on the centreline, two in the waist), four 1.1-inch/75 quadruple mounts, eight 20 mm Oerlikon Mk 4, two trainable quadruple 21-inch torpedo mounts, six depth-charge throwers and two stern tracks at the reference datums. Ballistics, rates and damage are shared provisional game calibration.

propulsion.basis: Provisional two-shaft unit machinery: each fireroom and engine room pair drives one shaft. Room bounds and routing are game estimates; the approved exterior reference does not show them.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

structuralPlating.note: Hull and superstructure plating read from the approved GameModels3D armour model (25 mm constructional hull, 13 mm superstructure); provisional game values, not a verified plating schedule.

accuracy.exterior: Original loft and superstructure blocks measured from the approved GameModels3D pasc107 B_Hull configuration (hull asc014_new_orlean_1944) at its design waterline; fittings are independently modelled approximations. No historical-accuracy claim.
accuracy.internals: Machinery, magazines, flood spaces and stability are provisional game estimates; the visual reference does not establish internal plans.
accuracy.weapons: Nine 8-inch/55 in three triple CA-32 pattern turrets, eight single 5-inch/25 Mk 19, six quadruple 40 mm Bofors Mk 2, seventeen twin and nine single 20 mm Oerlikons at the reference mount datums. Ballistics, rates and damage are shared provisional game calibration.

propulsion.basis: Provisional four-shaft machinery: four firerooms under the funnels and two engine rooms aft of them, one group per shaft with equal shares. Room bounds and routing are game estimates; the approved exterior reference does not show them.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. structuralPlating.note: Hull and superstructure plating read from the approved GameModels3D armour model (25 mm hull and upper side, 13 mm superstructure); provisional game values, not a verified plating schedule.

accuracy.exterior: Original loft and superstructure blocks measured from the approved GameModels3D pasc106 A hull (asc043_pensacola_1942) at its design waterline; fittings are independently modelled approximations. No historical-accuracy claim.
accuracy.internals: Machinery, magazines, flood spaces and stability are provisional game estimates; the visual reference does not establish internal plans.
accuracy.weapons: Ten 8-inch/55 in two twin Mk 14 Mod 2 and two triple Mk 14 Mod 1 turrets, eight 5-inch/25 Mk 19 open mounts, four 1.1-inch/75 quadruple mounts and eight 20 mm Oerlikon Mk 4 at the reference mount datums. Ballistics, rates and damage are shared provisional game calibration.

propulsion.basis: Provisional four-shaft machinery: four firerooms under the funnels and four turbine rooms aft of them, one group per shaft with equal shares. Room bounds and routing are game estimates; the approved exterior reference does not show them.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

structuralPlating.note: Hull, bulge and deckhouse plating thicknesses read from the approved GameModels3D armour model (26 mm constructional plating, 16 mm superstructure); provisional game values, not a verified plating schedule.

accuracy.exterior: Original loft and superstructure prisms measured from the approved GameModels3D pjsb006 B hull (jsb006_fuso_1943) at its design waterline; fittings are independently modelled approximations. No historical-accuracy claim.
accuracy.internals: Machinery, magazines, flood spaces and stability are provisional game estimates; the visual reference does not establish internal plans.
accuracy.weapons: Twelve 35.6 cm/45 Type 41 in six twin turrets, fourteen 15.2 cm/50 Type 41 casemates, eight 12.7 cm/40 Type 89 in four open twin mounts and thirty-seven 25 mm Type 96 (ten twin, seventeen single) at the reference mount datums. Ballistics, rates and damage are shared provisional game calibration.

propulsion.basis: Provisional four-shaft machinery: four boiler rooms between Nos. 2 and 3 turrets and under the funnel, four turbine rooms between Nos. 4 and 5 turrets, one group per shaft with equal shares. Room bounds and routing are estimates; the approved exterior reference does not show them.

underwaterProtection.basis: Estimated anti-torpedo bulge and side-protection system outside the belt (the reference armour model gives the bulge only as 26 mm plating); reductions are provisional game calibration, not a trials result.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

modules.name: Type 94 main battery director and 10 m rangefinder

structuralPlating.note: Hull, bulge and deckhouse plating are provisional game values matching the fleet's battleship calibration; the repository tools do not expose the reference's armour model.

accuracy.exterior: Original loft and superstructure prisms measured from the approved GameModels3D pjsb517 A hull (jsb049_hyuga_1942) at its design waterline; fittings are independently modelled approximations. No historical-accuracy claim.
accuracy.internals: Machinery, magazines, flood spaces and stability are provisional game estimates; the visual reference does not establish internal plans.
accuracy.weapons: Twelve 35.6 cm/45 Type 41 in six twin turrets, sixteen 14 cm/50 3rd Year Type casemates, eight 12.7 cm/40 Type 89 in four open twin mounts and twenty 25 mm Type 96 in ten twin mounts at the reference mount datums. Ballistics, rates and damage are shared provisional game calibration.

propulsion.basis: Provisional four-shaft machinery: four boiler rooms under the funnel between No. 2 and No. 3 barbettes and four turbine rooms between No. 4 and No. 5, one group per shaft with equal shares. Room bounds and routing are estimates; the approved exterior reference does not show them.

underwaterProtection.basis: Estimated anti-torpedo bulge and side-protection system outside the belt; reductions are provisional game calibration, not a trials result.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

accuracy.weapons: Eight 35.6 cm/45 Type 41 in four twin turrets, sixteen 12.7 cm/40 Type 89 in eight open twin mounts, 25 mm Type 96 in twenty-seven triple and eleven single mounts at the reference mount datums. The six 12 cm AA rocket launchers are visual fittings. Ballistics, rates and damage are shared provisional game calibration.

propulsion.basis: Provisional four-shaft machinery: four boiler rooms between No. 2 and No. 3 turrets and four turbine rooms abaft No. 4 turret, one group per shaft with equal shares. Room bounds and routing are game estimates; the approved exterior reference does not show them.

underwaterProtection.basis: Estimated anti-torpedo bulge and side-protection system outside the belt; reductions are provisional game calibration, not a trials result.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

nagato.name: IJN Nagato
nagato.configuration: Nagato · 1944 exterior after the GameModels3D pjsb010 B hull · reference design waterline

provenance.note: Stations measured from the approved GameModels3D Nagato A artillery visual; plate families are commonly published figures with estimated facet boundaries.

ballistics.basis: Provisional game calibration, not historical firing data. Linear k=0.5*1.225*0.25*area*muzzleSpeed/mass; no Mach curve. Angular/speed sigmas are estimated, capped at 3 sigma; no salvo correlation or rangefinder error. Legacy penetrationMm retained at 5000 m, 10 m launch/sea target, nominal speed (711.855 m/s); see assets/parts/calibrate-penetration.ts. Residual budget follows speed^1.4, including descent recovery; armor resistance paid separately.

ap.basis: Provisional AP game calibration, not historical fuze/filler data. Arming requires caliber/6 equivalent resistance in one non-ricochet contact; delay 35 ms at >=200 mm, otherwise 20 ms; fill 2.5% of projectile mass; fragment budget 8% of caliber in mm. Smaller AA AP remains inert. See assets/parts/author-ap.ts; blast radius and damage are bounded approximations.

he.basis: Provisional HE game calibration, not historical shell/stock data. Contact burst; fill 8% of nominal projectile mass, fragment budget caliber/6 in mm, burst damage twice the AP catalog value. 40% HE stock rounded down per barrel. Shares the gun nominal launch mass/speed/drag envelope as an approximation. See assets/parts/author-he.ts.

structures.name: Forecastle deck and casemate battery 3.5-6.5 m

structuralPlating.note: Constructional plating of 19 mm on the hull and 13 mm on the superstructure; provisional game values, not a verified plating schedule.

accuracy.exterior: Original loft and superstructure prisms measured from the approved GameModels3D pjsb010 B hull (jsb010_nagato_1944) at its design waterline; fittings are independently modelled approximations. No historical-accuracy claim.
accuracy.internals: Machinery, magazines, flood spaces and stability are provisional game estimates; the visual reference does not establish internal plans.
accuracy.weapons: Eight 41 cm/45 Type 3 in four twin turrets, eighteen 14 cm/50 3rd Year Type casemates, eight 12.7 cm/40 Type 89 in four twin mounts and 25 mm Type 96 in fourteen triple, twelve twin and twelve single mounts at the reference mount datums (twelve further singles are fixed fittings). Ballistics, rates and damage are shared provisional game calibration.

propulsion.basis: Provisional four-shaft machinery: four boiler rooms under the funnel and four turbine rooms between the funnel and No. 3 turret, one group per shaft with equal shares. Room bounds and routing are estimates; the approved exterior reference does not show them.

underwaterProtection.basis: Estimated anti-torpedo bulge and side-protection system outside the belt; reductions are provisional game calibration, not a trials result.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

takao.name: Takao
takao.configuration: Takao · 1944 exterior after the GameModels3D pjsc708 default fit (Takao-class 1944 hull) · reference design waterline

provenance.note: Closed gunhouse authored from horizontal slices and a roof raycast of the GameModels3D jgm146_203mm50_type_e reference; 25 mm all round is the commonly published Japanese heavy-cruiser turret plating, with estimated facet boundaries and a thin steel floor. The deep gun-port pockets of the reference are flattened into the closed face and redrawn as raised glacis ridges in the recipe.

ballistics.basis: Provisional game calibration, not historical firing data. Linear k=0.5*1.225*0.25*area*muzzleSpeed/mass; no Mach curve. Angular/speed sigmas are estimated, capped at 3 sigma; no salvo correlation or rangefinder error. Legacy penetrationMm retained at 5000 m, 10 m launch/sea target, nominal speed (674.781 m/s); see assets/parts/calibrate-penetration.ts. Residual budget follows speed^1.4, including descent recovery; armor resistance paid separately.

ap.basis: Provisional AP game calibration, not historical fuze/filler data. Arming requires caliber/6 equivalent resistance in one non-ricochet contact; delay 35 ms at >=200 mm, otherwise 20 ms; fill 2.5% of projectile mass; fragment budget 8% of caliber in mm. Smaller AA AP remains inert. See assets/parts/author-ap.ts; blast radius and damage are bounded approximations.

he.basis: Provisional HE game calibration, not historical shell/stock data. Contact burst; fill 8% of nominal projectile mass, fragment budget caliber/6 in mm, burst damage twice the AP catalog value. 40% HE stock rounded down per barrel. Shares the gun nominal launch mass/speed/drag envelope as an approximation. See assets/parts/author-he.ts.

structuralPlating.note: Hull and superstructure plating read from the approved GameModels3D armour model (25 mm constructional hull, 16 mm superstructure); provisional game values, not a verified plating schedule.

accuracy.exterior: Original loft and superstructure blocks measured from the approved GameModels3D pjsc708 default configuration (Takao-class 1944 hull jsc038_atago_1944) at its design waterline; fittings are independently modelled approximations. No historical-accuracy claim.
accuracy.internals: Machinery, magazines, flood spaces and stability are provisional game estimates; the visual reference does not establish internal plans.
accuracy.weapons: Ten 20.3 cm/50 in five twin Model E turrets, eight 12.7 cm/40 Type 89 in four open twin mounts, 25 mm Type 96 in six triple, six twin and thirty single mounts, and sixteen 610 mm tubes in four trainable quadruple mounts at the reference mount datums. Ballistics, rates and damage are shared provisional game calibration.

propulsion.basis: Provisional four-shaft machinery: three boiler rooms under the funnels and four turbine rooms aft of them, one group per shaft with equal shares. Room bounds and routing are game estimates; the approved exterior reference does not show them.

underwaterProtection.basis: Estimated anti-torpedo bulge and lower citadel side outside the machinery; reductions are provisional game calibration, not a trials result.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

ap.basis: Provisional AP game calibration, not historical fuze/filler data. Arming requires caliber/6 equivalent resistance in one non-ricochet contact; delay 35 ms at >=200 mm, otherwise 20 ms; fill 2.5% of projectile mass; fragment budget 8% of caliber in mm. Smaller AA AP remains inert. See assets/parts/author-ap.ts; blast radius and damage are bounded approximations.

ballistics.basis: Provisional game calibration, not historical firing data. Linear k=0.5*1.225*0.25*area*muzzleSpeed/mass; no Mach curve. Angular/speed sigmas are estimated, capped at 3 sigma; no salvo correlation or rangefinder error. Legacy penetrationMm retained at 5000 m, 10 m launch/sea target, nominal speed (485.109 m/s); see assets/parts/calibrate-penetration.ts. Residual budget follows speed^1.4, including descent recovery; armor resistance paid separately.

he.basis: Provisional HE game calibration, not historical shell/stock data. Contact burst; fill 8% of nominal projectile mass, fragment budget caliber/6 in mm, burst damage twice the AP catalog value. 40% HE stock rounded down per barrel. Shares the gun nominal launch mass/speed/drag envelope as an approximation. See assets/parts/author-he.ts.

accuracy.exterior: Original construction against the approved pgsc108 A fit: hull lines, deckhouse outlines, platform and mast heights measured from it; geometry authored independently. Fidelity to that model, not an independent historical survey.
accuracy.internals: Provisional game compartments and loading, not historical plans.
accuracy.weapons: Approved A fit: four 203 mm twins, six 105 mm twins, four 37 mm twins, six 40 mm singles, eight 20 mm twins, six 20 mm singles, and four triple 533 mm launchers. Ballistics, stocks, armor, and operating limits are provisional game conventions.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

ballistics.basis: Provisional game calibration, not historical firing data. Linear k=0.5*1.225*0.25*area*muzzleSpeed/mass; no Mach curve. ap.basis: Provisional AP game calibration, not historical fuze/filler data. Smaller AA AP remains inert. See assets/parts/author-ap.ts; blast radius and damage are bounded approximations.

accuracy.exterior: Original reconstruction against approved GameModels3D Hull A at 15 metres per source unit and source Y=0 waterline. Fine fittings and weathering are simplified; historical loading and year are unverified.
accuracy.internals: Estimated game envelopes for alternating machinery spaces, magazines, four shaft drives and steering; not a recovered historical internal plan.
accuracy.weapons: Approved Hull A armament uses original articulated builders and CPU installation-clearance interlocks. Performance, armor and interlock envelopes are provisional game values, not verified historical mechanical stops.

structures.name: Pilot house roof and lookout platform

propulsion.basis: Provisional four-shaft cruiser game layout with alternating boiler/turbine spaces and equal drive shares. Internal boundaries, routing and machinery dimensions are estimates; the approved exterior reference does not verify them.

structuralPlating.note: Provisional game steel thicknesses; no historically verified plating schedule.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

accuracy.weapons: Independent gunhouse polygons; historical bore and turret frames. Simplified geometry and AP budget, no fuze, spall or material penetration model. 150 mm turrets and AA mounts (eight twin 105 mm, eight twin 37 mm, twelve single 20 mm) on the reference hardpoints with provisional CPU fire control. structuralPlating.note: Provisional ordinary steel: 20 mm hull shell and 8 mm deckhouse/funnel walls. These are gameplay estimates, not a verified historical plating schedule. Authored surfaces register hits independently of armor; nearby exterior armor takes precedence.

propulsion.basis: Three turbine/shaft groups share a six-room boiler pool. Equal shaft shares, steam routing and immersion thresholds are provisional gameplay calibration.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

underwaterProtection.basis: Provisional gameplay underwater defense zones: central side coverage and 50% reductions are estimated, not measured historical protection ratings. Ends and keel remain unprotected; no progressive defense failure is modeled.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

he.basis: Provisional HE game calibration, not historical shell/stock data. Shares the gun nominal launch mass/speed/drag envelope as an approximation. See assets/parts/author-he.ts.

modules.name: Main battery director and 10 m rangefinder

structuralPlating.note: Hull, bulge and deckhouse plating thicknesses read from the approved GameModels3D armour model (19 mm constructional plating, 13 mm superstructure); provisional game values, not a verified plating schedule.

accuracy.exterior: Original loft and superstructure prisms measured from the approved GameModels3D pjsb007 B hull (jsb007_kongo_1942) at its design waterline; fittings are independently modelled approximations. No historical-accuracy claim.
accuracy.internals: Machinery, magazines, flood spaces and stability are provisional game estimates; the visual reference does not establish internal plans.
accuracy.weapons: Eight 35.6 cm/45 Type 41 in four twin turrets, fourteen 15.2 cm Type 41 casemates, eight 12.7 cm/40 Type 89 in four open twin mounts, twelve 25 mm Type 96 in six twin mounts and ten 13.2 mm Type 93 (four twin, two single) at the reference mount datums. Ballistics, rates and damage are shared provisional game calibration.

propulsion.basis: Provisional four-shaft machinery: four boiler rooms under the funnels and four turbine rooms between No. 3 and No. 4 turrets, one group per shaft with equal shares. Room bounds and routing are estimates; the approved exterior reference does not show them.

underwaterProtection.basis: Estimated anti-torpedo bulge and side-protection system outside the belt; reductions are provisional game calibration, not a trials result.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

ballistics.basis: Estimated linear drag from projectile mass, bore area, muzzle speed, air density 1.225 kg/m3 and Cd 0.25; penetration budget referenced at 1000 m. Shared game approximation; no historical firing-table or Mach-curve claim. See assets/parts/author-plausible-ballistics.ts.

structuralPlating.note: Provisional ordinary steel; original external loft drives both rendering and CPU hits.

accuracy.exterior: Independently authored against approved GameModels3D pasb018 A; 1943 label shares 1945 hull. Launch-day fit, paint shades and loading unverified.
accuracy.internals: Provisional compartment, armor and machinery layout for shared flooding, damage control and propulsion; not historical certification.
accuracy.weapons: Source caliber/count, main AP speed/mass and main/127 mm sectors; remaining projectile and AA mount performance are provisional game calibration.

propulsion.basis: Four provisional independent drive groups using the shared machinery simulation; internal room allocation is not historically certified.

damageControl.basis: Provisional battleship crew and finite stores calibration shared with player-built definitions.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

alaska.name: USS Alaska
alaska.configuration: CB-1 · 1944-45 exterior after the GameModels3D pasc510 A hull · reference design waterline

provenance.note: Original faceted enclosure measured against the approved GameModels3D Alaska A artillery (agm177_12in50_mk8_triple) stations. Plate families follow the commonly published 325 mm face, 133 mm side and rear and 127 mm roof figures; facet boundaries, the rear rounding and the floor are game estimates.

ballistics.basis: Provisional game calibration, not historical firing data. Linear k=0.5*1.225*0.25*area*muzzleSpeed/mass; no Mach curve. Residual budget follows speed^1.4, including descent recovery; armor resistance paid separately.

ap.basis: Provisional AP game calibration, not historical fuze/filler data. Smaller AA AP remains inert. See assets/parts/author-ap.ts; blast radius and damage are bounded approximations.

structuralPlating.note: Bow and stern shell and deckhouse plating thicknesses read from the approved GameModels3D armour model; used as provisional game values, not a verified plating schedule.

accuracy.exterior: Original loft and deckhouse tiers measured from the approved GameModels3D pasc510 A hull at its design waterline; fittings are independently modelled approximations. No historical-accuracy claim.
accuracy.internals: Machinery, magazines, flood spaces and stability are provisional game estimates; the visual reference does not establish internal plans.
accuracy.weapons: Nine 12-inch/50 Mk 8, twelve 5-inch/38 Mk 12 on Mk 32 Mod 12, fourteen shielded quad 40 mm Bofors and thirty-four 20 mm Oerlikons at the reference mount datums. Ballistics, rates and damage are shared provisional game calibration.

propulsion.basis: Provisional unit machinery: alternating firerooms and engine rooms feeding two shaft pairs with equal shares. Room bounds and routing are estimates; the approved exterior reference does not show them.

underwaterProtection.basis: Estimated side-protection system behind the belt; reductions are provisional game calibration, not a trials result.

damageControl.basis: Provisional large-cruiser crew and finite-stores calibration between the fleet cruiser and battleship values; not historical manning or damage-control performance.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

structuralPlating.note: Nominal collision skin only; exact plating scantlings not recovered.

accuracy.exterior: Early-1941 fit. Hull lines, waterline, superstructure tiers and mount datums measured from the approved GameModels3D pbsb107 model; the early-1941 light AA, radar and aircraft kept from the original recipe informed by Vickers plans and IWM photographs. Fidelity to that model, not an independent historical survey.
accuracy.internals: Estimated machinery, magazines, partitions, flooding and stability for inspectable combat; not an as-built internal survey.
accuracy.weapons: Ten 14-inch and sixteen 5.25-inch guns. Source-based bore, layout, speed and train/elevation; ballistics and damage calibrated for gameplay. Pom-poms, UP and aircraft are visual only.

propulsion.basis: Four equal turbine/shaft trains supplied by paired boilers. Eight boilers and four turbines are documented; room bounds and routing are estimated; shafts aggregated with turbines.

damageControl.basis: Shared provisional battleship crew/fuel/repair calibration; not historical manning, flash trials or damage-control performance.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

underwaterProtection.basis: Provisional gameplay underwater defense zones: central side coverage and 50% reductions are estimated, not measured historical protection ratings. Ends and keel remain unprotected; no progressive defense failure is modeled.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

provenance.note: Original faceted hood measured from the approved GameModels3D Black Swan A artillery (bgs006_4in45_qf_mk_xix): station loft of the flanks, crown and raked front, a floor at 0.39 m and the open back declared as an aperture. The approved visual closes its crown over the guns, which would foul them above roughly +30 degrees; the two port slots carried here open that crown so the published high-angle travel clears. Splinter-plate thickness is a game estimate, not an armor certification.

accuracy.exterior: Original May 1941 reconstruction against the approved GameModels3D pbsb507 model: hull lines, tier outlines and mount datums measured from it; geometry authored independently. Fidelity to that model, not an independent historical survey.
accuracy.internals: Estimated magazines, boiler and engine rooms, partitions, flooding and stability for inspectable combat; not an as-built internal survey.
accuracy.weapons: Eight 15-inch Mk II, fourteen 4-inch Mk XIX and three octuple pom-poms fire; ballistics and damage are shared game calibration. The four quadruple .50 Vickers and five UP projectors are visual only.

propulsion.basis: Four equal turbine/shaft trains, each fed by two of eight boiler-room groups (Hood carried 24 small-tube boilers). Room bounds and routing are estimated; shafts aggregated with turbines.

underwaterProtection.basis: Provisional gameplay underwater defense: external bulges over the citadel, central side coverage and 40% reductions estimated from the reference bulge and 38 mm torpedo bulkhead, not measured historical protection ratings. Ends and keel remain unprotected.

damageControl.basis: Shared provisional battleship crew/fuel/repair calibration; not historical manning, flash trials or damage-control performance.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. provenance.note: Original enclosure from retained section/photo evidence. Plate families are provisional where the primary plate schedule is absent; no uniform gunhouse box is added.

ballistics.basis: Provisional game calibration, not historical firing data. Linear k=0.5*1.225*0.25*area*muzzleSpeed/mass; no Mach curve. Angular/speed sigmas are estimated, capped at 3 sigma; no salvo correlation or rangefinder error. Legacy penetrationMm retained at 5000 m, 10 m launch/sea target, nominal speed (637.693 m/s); see assets/parts/calibrate-penetration.ts. Residual budget follows speed^1.4, including descent recovery; armor resistance paid separately.

ap.basis: Provisional AP game calibration, not historical fuze/filler data. Arming requires caliber/6 equivalent resistance in one non-ricochet contact; delay 35 ms at >=200 mm, otherwise 20 ms; fill 2.5% of projectile mass; fragment budget 8% of caliber in mm. Smaller AA AP remains inert. See assets/parts/author-ap.ts; blast radius and damage are bounded approximations.

he.basis: Provisional HE game calibration, not historical shell/stock data. Contact burst; fill 8% of nominal projectile mass, fragment budget caliber/6 in mm, burst damage twice the AP catalog value. 40% HE stock rounded down per barrel. Shares the gun nominal launch mass/speed/drag envelope as an approximation. See assets/parts/author-he.ts.

accuracy.exterior: Hull lines (151 control stations), deckhouse tiers, funnels, masts, director and mount stations measured from the approved GameModels3D pasc108 A_Hull model; geometry authored independently. Fidelity to that model, not an independent historical survey. The preset keeps its October 1943 radar and equipment fit.
accuracy.internals: Physical protection surfaces and contained provisional room envelopes. Thickness families, boundaries, capacities, flooding and ballistics remain estimates; see fidelity-01 evidence.
accuracy.weapons: Original catalog-based 8-inch triple / 5-inch twin components; primary turret section OP1112 p517. Secondary shield details and AA fittings remain under review. The twelve quad 40 mm Bofors mounts now use shared aiming, finite ammunition and damage alongside the six twin 5-inch DP mounts. AA rates and arcs are gameplay approximations; the single 20 mm fittings remain visual.

structuralPlating.note: Nominal 16 mm hull / 6 mm structure steel, estimated for gameplay where no verified plate schedule exists. Exterior armor replaces coincident skin. Fit date and load datum stay separate.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

propulsion.basis: Two retained combined-drive envelopes represent the cruiser machinery plant with equal provisional power shares; individual boilers and shafts remain aggregated.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

accuracy.weapons: Provisional game calibration using existing cruiser conventions; exterior fitted to approved GameModels3D pjsc009 A_Hull/AB2_Artillery. No independently verified historical ballistics or mechanical-stop claim.

structuralPlating.note: Provisional ordinary steel, separate from estimated armor.

propulsion.basis: Provisional game calibration using existing cruiser conventions; exterior fitted to approved GameModels3D pjsc009 A_Hull/AB2_Artillery. No independently verified historical ballistics or mechanical-stop claim.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

enterprise-cv6.name: USS Enterprise (CV-6)
enterprise-cv6.configuration: June 1942, Battle of Midway; pre-bulge hull; reconstruction in progress

ballistics.basis: Provisional game calibration, not historical firing data. Linear k=0.5*1.225*0.25*area*muzzleSpeed/mass; no Mach curve. Angular/speed sigmas are estimated, capped at 3 sigma; no salvo correlation or rangefinder error. Legacy penetrationMm retained at 5000 m, 10 m launch/sea target, nominal speed (485.109 m/s); see assets/parts/calibrate-penetration.ts. Residual budget follows speed^1.4, including descent recovery; armor resistance paid separately.

ap.basis: Provisional AP game calibration, not historical fuze/filler data. Arming requires caliber/6 equivalent resistance in one non-ricochet contact; delay 35 ms at >=200 mm, otherwise 20 ms; fill 2.5% of projectile mass; fragment budget 8% of caliber in mm. Smaller AA AP remains inert. See assets/parts/author-ap.ts; blast radius and damage are bounded approximations.

he.basis: Provisional HE game calibration, not historical shell/stock data. Contact burst; fill 8% of nominal projectile mass, fragment budget caliber/6 in mm, burst damage twice the AP catalog value. 40% HE stock rounded down per barrel. Shares the gun nominal launch mass/speed/drag envelope as an approximation. See assets/parts/author-he.ts.

structures.name: Pilot house roof and director platform

accuracy.exterior: Dimensional reconstruction from CV-6 contract offsets, CV-5 as-built plans and CV-6 1942 photos. See open discrepancies; not certified 100% accurate.
accuracy.internals: Physical protection surfaces and contained provisional room envelopes. Thickness families, boundaries, capacities, flooding and ballistics remain estimates; see fidelity-01 evidence.
accuracy.weapons: 8 single 5-inch/38, 4 quadruple 1.1-inch, 30 single 20 mm. Local fitting geometry, some placements and ballistic/damage values remain provisional.

structuralPlating.note: Nominal 15.875 mm hull / 6 mm structure steel, estimated for gameplay where no verified plate schedule exists. Exterior armor replaces coincident skin. Fit date and load datum stay separate.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

propulsion.basis: Forward and aft boiler groups supply one aggregated turbine group representing four shafts. Steam routing, immersion thresholds and availability are provisional.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.

Provisional game calibration, not historical firing data. Linear k=0.5*1.225*0.25*area*muzzleSpeed/mass; no Mach curve. Angular/speed sigmas are estimated, capped at 3 sigma; no salvo correlation or rangefinder error. Legacy penetrationMm retained at 1000 m, 10 m launch/sea target, nominal speed (508.570 m/s); see assets/parts/calibrate-penetration.ts. Residual budget follows speed^1.4, including descent recovery; armor resistance paid separately.

he.basis: Provisional HE game calibration, not historical shell/stock data. Contact burst; fill 8% of nominal projectile mass, fragment budget caliber/6 in mm, burst damage twice the AP catalog value. 40% HE stock rounded down per barrel. Shares the gun nominal launch mass/speed/drag envelope as an approximation. See assets/parts/author-he.ts.

Forward machinery casing and torpedo deck
After gun deck and AA overhang

structuralPlating.note: Provisional steel plating for gameplay, not surveyed armor.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

propulsion.basis: Provisional game assignment of two equally weighted boiler/turbine trains; exact machinery interconnections are not established by the approved exterior reference.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.
